messages.subject: For Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia | Cloud infrastructure, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Bond,

Please place this executive introduction before Oracle Co-CEOs Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia.

Oracle's rapid cloud and AI-infrastructure expansion increasingly operates at the intersection of governments, regulated industries, strategic infrastructure and responsible technology. That stakeholder environment aligns closely with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex cross-functional matters across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, regulated-market execution and global stakeholder strategy might support Oracle's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Oracle.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
